leads.name: The Lime of Šaľa (Šalianska lipa)
leads.why: Register-protected (data/registers/slovakia-chranene-stromy.json register_id 163) for its 'mighty growth and health', and independently listed by sk.wikipedia's national protected-trees list (entry S163), which is the second source for existence and species. No age or girth in either fetched source: a WebSearch AI summary claimed girth 521cm, height 30m and 150+ years, but per this project's rule a search summary is a lead and not a source, so those figures are NOT recorded as fact. ACCESS UNRESOLVED: the register locality reads 'courtyard of a former nursery/creche (jasle)' on the Sidlisko Vah housing estate, which is often fenced and not freely walk-in; not confirmed either way. Needs both a fetched source for age/girth and an access check before this could ever ship.
